description: Publish a skill to your organization's private registry. Requires Enterprise tier (private_registry feature). Skills are scoped to your team's registry namespace and published versions are immutable. A published version is not installable by teammates until a team admin approves it — see private_registry_manage action "submissions" to check its status.

content.description: Packaged skill files as a { path: text } map; must include "SKILL.md" (max 2 MB total)

name: private_registry_publish
title: Publish to Private Registry
